hero.alt: Fine vertical lines connect an upper row of slate bars to lower blocks, where an orange rectangle encloses the middle group.
hero.caption: The orange frame encloses only the blocks linked to the upper specification, illustrating the scope of the proof over the compiled code.
hero.prompt: Create a wide landscape editorial hero for Yesterday in AI, approximately 3:2 or wider. International Typographic Style translated into a crisp conceptual graphic: warm ivory paper (#F8F6F0), deep slate (#101820), restrained burnt-orange (#BF4714) signal, fine hairlines, precise geometry, ample negative space, flat matte finish. One visual relationship tied to formal verification of compiled Signal cryptographic code. Show two aligned, clearly separate horizontal layers on the paper. The upper layer is a short slate rule with a small set of precisely cut notches, standing for a human-approved formal specification. The lower layer is a dense, orderly field of slate rectangular modules, standing for the compiled binary. An ultra-thin slate alignment grid leads from the upper notches down to matching positions in the lower layer. A single narrow burnt-orange rectangular frame encloses only the modules covered by the proof, leaving visibly similar slate modules outside the frame on both sides. Let the orange frame convey proof scope, without a checkmark. Center the composition with generous margins. Use strong contrast and clean graphic geometry that survives thumbnail size. No text, digits, letters, logos, gradients, texture, photographic elements, people, padlocks, robots, watermarks, pseudo-code, decorative circuitry, or plotted data. Keep all essential forms comfortably inside the frame.
